about: Extra DOSM releases checked every week by scripts/check_dosm.py. NOTIFY-ONLY: a change opens/updates the dosm-update issue; nothing is downloaded or ingested. Fields: id, name, url (direct file or page URL; null = not set up yet), local (file name in dosm/ that holds your manual copy, optional), known (fingerprint of the version you already have: ETag or Last-Modified as printed in the weekly report; null = take the local file's MD5 when the server's ETag is an MD5, otherwise just report the current fingerprint). After you download a new release into dosm/, either the MD5 comparison clears the alert on its own or you paste the new fingerprint into known.
